census-decreasing.description: decreasing steps of R_c over the computed range

census-flat.description: flat steps of R_c over the computed range

census-increasing.description: increasing steps of R_c over the computed range

census-steps.description: total steps examined in the monotonicity census

decreasing-fraction.description: percentage of steps that decrease, over the computed range

flat-step-last.description: largest N at which a flat step occurs

fluctuation-max.description: maximum local ratio over the computed range

fluctuation-median.description: median of R_c(N+1)/R_c(N) over the computed range

fluctuation-min.description: minimum local ratio over the computed range

n-max.description: largest N for which R_c was computed exactly

rc-bit-length.description: bit length of R_c at the largest N
